meta.title: Freely we give — support Christian Culture
meta.description: Radio, television, the Audio Bible and a daily Bible lesson are free for everyone. Voluntary support — a gift, prayer, sharing or volunteering — lets Christian Culture keep giving.
meta.ogDescription: Free radio, TV, Audio Bible and a daily Bible lesson. Your voluntary support helps us keep giving.

hero.lead: Radio, television, the Audio Bible, the Academy, films, news and community — the whole Christian Culture ecosystem is free for everyone. Your voluntary support helps us keep giving.

eko.lead: 16 places online. No ads, no paid tiers and no selling of data. The daily lesson of our Bible course — today is day {dzien} — the Audio Bible, live streams and portals exist thanks to people who give voluntarily. Most services are in Polish; Christian Culture Global broadcasts for listeners worldwide.

mojabiblia: an interlinear Bible and translation comparison

panel.h2: Choose how you want to give
panel.lead: Once or regularly, from Poland or from abroad. Every amount is voluntary.
panel.uwaga: This page does not take payments or confirm gifts. Never enter card details, BLIK codes or passwords here — payment always happens in your bank or on the service the button leads to.

blik.p: Only from Polish banks. In your banking app choose “BLIK phone transfer” and enter the number below.
blik.uwaga: Works only with Polish banks that support BLIK phone transfers. From abroad, choose “Online”.

przelew.p: Two accounts in Polish złoty — choose the purpose closest to your heart.
przelew.uwaga: Both accounts are held in PLN. We do not publish a SWIFT/BIC code on this page; from abroad, Revolut or Patronite is the simplest way.

patronite.p: Monthly patronage on Patronite, a Polish platform, helps us plan recordings and broadcasts month by month. You choose the amount and duration and can end it at any time.

revolut.p: A one-off gift through a secure Revolut link. The payment methods and currencies available are shown by Revolut itself.

zrzutka.p: The fundraisers on Zrzutka.pl are run by Wioletta Rogowska. Goals, descriptions and current progress are on the Zrzutka.pl pages (in Polish).

bez.udostepnijTekst: Christian Culture gives everything for free:

ktory.p1: Cezary Rogowski leads Christian Culture together with people who give their time to the mission. Bank transfers and BLIK go to his accounts, the Zrzutka.pl fundraisers are run by Wioletta Rogowska, and Patronite and Revolut show the recipient on their own pages. Every gift serves to keep the radio, television, Audio Bible and Academy free.
ktory.p2: Christian Culture is an independent, private Christian initiative. It is not affiliated with Polskie Radio S.A. or any public broadcaster, and it does not promise any tax relief.

items: Does this page confirm my gift?
No. Copying a number or clicking a button is not a payment. Payment happens only in your bank or on Patronite, Revolut or Zrzutka.pl, where you also see its confirmation.
Can I deduct my gift from my taxes?
We do not promise that. Transfers go to a private person — Cezary Rogowski. Please ask your tax adviser about your situation.
I live abroad. How can I help?
BLIK phone transfers work only with Polish banks, and our accounts are in PLN. From abroad, Revolut or patronage on Patronite is the simplest way.
What is the difference between patronage and a gift?
Patronage on Patronite is regular monthly support that you can end at any time. A bank transfer, BLIK, Revolut or a fundraiser is a one-off gift.

The “Rozwój Christian Culture” account funds the studio, radio, television and technology. The “Dar misyjny” account funds apps, Bible content and evangelism. Patronage and online gifts support the whole mission.
Only with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw — and never with an amount or bank details.
